verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents official server-side SDKs for Node.js, PHP, Python, .NET, Java and Ruby, each with its own install or configuration instructions, and SDK release notes. It also documents front-end SDKs such as Checkout, Elements, Vault and Profiler. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and maintenance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Get started in your language: Node.js PHP Python .NET Java Ruby
The Mangopay Node.js SDK makes working with the Mangopay API easier in a Node.js environment.
The SDK is published as an artifact on Mangopay's Maven Central Repository and can be used with Gradle or Maven.
